Our Story
Breaches keep starting with people. Not because people are careless - because the tools supposed to prepare them were built for a different era. We’re building the platform that finally closes the gap between how attackers operate and how organizations train.

Security has long treated people as the weakest link.
We believe the opposite. When employees understand the risks
around them, they become the strongest line of defense.

We are a team of security experts who believe resilience starts with people.

We helps organizations empower their employees to understand modern threats and act as the strongest line of defense.
